comparison_vs_pci_2011.reference: bridgebeams.us.AashtoIBeamSection (PCI BDM Appendix B-7, Nov 2011, inch dimensions x 25.4)
comparison_vs_pci_2011.metric: max_vertex_mm = largest distance from a PH vertex to the nearest US vertex; hausdorff_mm = outline Hausdorff distance; sym_diff_mm2 = symmetric-difference area; area/ixx ratios PH/US (gross, about centroid)

V-as-drawn.note: All vertices within 0.5 mm of Type VI except the two bottom-flange corners (660 vs 711.2 mm width: 25.6 mm per side).

V-as-drawn_vs_US_V.note: depth 1829 vs 1600.2 mm; not a rounding difference

discrepancies: Slide 'TYPE V' has the depth and top/web geometry of AASHTO Type VI (1829 mm = 72 in), not Type V (1600 mm); kept as size 'V-as-drawn'.
Slide 'TYPE V' bottom flange printed 660 mm; PCI Type VI (and V) B2 = 711.2 mm. Implemented as printed; pinned in tests.
Types II, III, IV vertical chains miss overall depth by 1 mm (913/1144/1371); web absorbs residual.
